about_the_game:
Expect a fast-paced FPS experience wrapped in a retro, liminal vibe.

EARLY ACCESS 0.4 FEATURES

  • 13 unique weapons + 10 specialized gadgets

  • 140+ stackable items

  • 100+ variants to explore and purge through

  • 35+ entities with their unique personalities and mechanics

  • 12 boss battles

  • Hub world and arcade with classic minigames to win even more prizes

  • Sandbox editor for custom levels (experimental)

  • 52 Achievements, yea it's a full deck of cards

  • 13 soundtrack cassettes, each capable of changing your run. Not enough? Import your own music and the game will generate a custom cassette with randomized stats based on the file. Your playlist is now a build mechanic.

  • LEADERBOARDS for all type of objectives

  • Gamble every second with never more than 5 minutes until your DEATH

Warning!

This game contains flashing effects that may be unsuitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions.
requirements_minimum:

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or later
  • Processor: 2.4GHZ Dual Core Processor Or Higher
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 9800GT Or Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
